function onlyUndefined(x: undefined) {
  return 'missing';
}
function onlyNull(x: null) {
  return 'none';
}
function onlyB(s: { k: 'b'; v: null }) {
  return s.k;
}
type S = { k: 'a'; v: number } | { k: 'b'; v: null };

function text(x: string | undefined) {
  return x ?? onlyUndefined(x);
}
function count(x: number | null) {
  return x ?? onlyNull(x);
}
function property(o: { p: string | null }) {
  return o.p ?? onlyNull(o.p);
}
function discriminant(s: S) {
  return s.v ?? onlyB(s);
}

console.log(text('a'), text(undefined));
console.log(count(0), count(null));
console.log(property({ p: 'p' }), property({ p: null }));
console.log(discriminant({ k: 'a', v: 1 }), discriminant({ k: 'b', v: null }));
